inputs.rule: events: the last year with any row

inputs.vanish_rule: 100% missing over every group's rows of the test year (D18)

inputs.rule: T-MARK (SPEC_TABLE_MODE.md 2.1)

value.rule: T-MARK: marks equal the derived window (O1)

inputs.rule: ruling U1: no lag is computed for a table; each lead's file holds features that already end before the row's issue date (vouched by the package owner, U2)
latest content epoch at or before each cut's own last day (D19, D27)

excluded_groups: Gulf of Guinea to Sierra Leone
Pompey and Swain Reefs, south-east Great Barrier Reef
inputs.rule: owner ruling U1: the table option; the package supplies one row per sample in one table per lead, the engine computes no lag and runs no package code, and checks the dates it can check
owner ruling U2

value: U2: features vouched by the package owner (owner ruling U2); the engine recomputes none of them

1. every feature and context value of a lead-L row uses only content dated strictly before its issue date, in the source's own day convention (publication delay disclosed per source in exceptions.yaml)
2. no feature reads the row's own label, a label of any test row, or any label dated on or after the issue date
3. the issue date equals the target date minus L days (checked by the engine: T-ISSUE)
4. the same row id means the same sample, with the same label, in every lead file (checked: T-LEADSET)
5. the target date is the label's last content day

6. key_feature_end is the last content day any of the row's feature windows may read; the engine checks that it is before the issue day on every row (T-FEATEND) but cannot check that the declaration is true
the G-DERIVED recompute and the look-ahead canary are not run on tables (U2)
